entities.name: Sequence query dITP/XTPase
observations: 205-aa sequence has a Ham1p_like domain (PF01725.22; residues 10–199).
Strong homology to reviewed bacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases; best hit Q5LWF7 has 72.9% identity and 99% query coverage.

Homology suggests Mg2+-dependent hydrolysis of XTP, dITP and ITP to corresponding monophosphates, helping remove noncanonical purine nucleotides and reduce their incorporation into nucleic acids; exact substrate specificity for query is inferred, not experimentally established.

entities.name: Q5LWF7
observations: Reviewed Ruegeria pomeroyi dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase, EC 3.6.1.66; homology reference for sequence query (72.9% identity, 99% coverage).
Annotated as Mg2+-dependent and active on XTP, dITP and ITP; implicated in purine nucleoside triphosphate catabolism and nucleotide-pool sanitization.
